fixes.what: The tests imported ../scripts/lib.mjs and ../scripts/admit.mjs and ran ../scripts/<name>.mjs. They now use ../lib.mjs, ../admit.mjs and ../<name>.mjs, as the flat build layout requires.

tcb/test/helpers.mjs (CONTRACT 4.11) still does not exist, and it is not this group's file. Each test now imports helpers.mjs when it exists and otherwise uses a stand-in inside the test file (makeRoot, fakeTranscript, spawnSleeper, fakeProc). The stand-in is taken from the one in lib.test.mjs and made synchronous, because these tests call the helpers without await.

T2 'differing e_task -> plan-differs' asserted that the ledger was byte-identical. The spec contradicts itself here: its T2 says 'table and ledger unchanged', but its Writes section says there is an incident {class: refusal} on exits 1, 5 and 6, and R58 says every refusal is an incident line. I followed Writes and R58. The test now asserts that the table is byte-identical, that the old ledger bytes are an unchanged prefix, that exactly one line was added (an incident of class refusal), that there is no second plan line, and that the ledger verifies. This makes the test stricter, not weaker.

The fixture expected run/ledger.jsonl to be 'absent' after exit 1 plan-invalid. That conflicts with the same R58 and Writes rule, because the refusal appends an incident line. It now expects run/tasks.json to be byte-identical (checked by its sha256) and run/ledger.jsonl to be present.

bind called lib.attemptOf(row, E) before it checked the row's state and step. A bind on a planned row (epoch 0, no attempts) therefore exited 2 no-attempt instead of 65 wrong-step, and selftest failed the fixture replace/bad-bind-wrong-step. The attempt is now looked up only after the step check has established that one must exist.

This was not a test failure. stop removed its sample file with fs.rmSync. It now uses lib.removeFile, which the library exports now and which has the Windows file-sharing retries the builder asked for.

still_failing: Nothing fails in admit.test.mjs, stop.test.mjs or replace.test.mjs, and this group's 14 selftest fixture cases pass. Seven tests are skipped by design as needs-app.
